verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Computer can process CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF, images, audio and video files. Files are uploaded (up to 200 MB) into a sandboxed Linux VM with Python and standard tools, which covers uploading documents, spreadsheets and PDFs and analyzing them. missing for 10: evidence that the analysis is accurate, independent or hands-on corroboration of file analysis, and in-depth docs on document and PDF handling beyond one-line capability claims.
